title: Lunchline letter rise
description: A heading split into letters that rise into place through their word's mask: the first letter starts just below its place, each next one further down, so a line settles like a wave from left to right. Scrubbed with the scroll as the heading enters (scroll mode), or once on load (load mode, 22ms apart, with a fade).
notes: takes plain text (it splits on spaces, then into letters); screen readers get the whole text from aria-label
CSS only: without scroll-driven animations, or with reduced motion, the text simply stands
use load mode only for a heading in the first screen
